title: The conjectured extension of the Burnside–Stirling–Gautschi bound
statement:
Let $\widehat{m}_{1/2}(x,\alpha)$ denote the logarithmic error term for the shifted interpolation parameter $\alpha$, let $\widehat{D}_{1/2}$ be its stated domain, and let $\overline{b_{SG}^\star}$ be the upper Burnside–Stirling–Gautschi bound. **The conjectured extension of the Burnside–Stirling–Gautschi bound.** For all $(x,\alpha)\in\widehat{D}_{1/2}$,

$$
\widehat{m}_{1/2}(x,\alpha)\leq\overline{b_{SG}^\star}(x+\alpha).
$$

Equivalently, the restriction $x\geq 1$ appearing in the preceding corollary should not be necessary. The claim is motivated by the numerical comparisons in the paper, and no resolution is supplied in the given text.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21906

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2026).
source_name: Marc Schmidlin, “On Gautschi & Stirling Identities, Asymptotics and Inequalities for the Pi (or Gamma) Function”, arXiv:2601.21906 (2026).
